subject: Initial discovery — Redwood x Acme Health: aligning stakeholders
messages:
From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial discovery — Redwood x Acme Health: aligning stakeholders

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the intro call last week — really appreciate the time. Per our conversation, we'd like to set a short 45–60 min discovery with your engineering lead and whatever stakeholders you think are necessary (procurement/security if they want an early touch).

Suggested windows (PT / ET):
- Tue 2026-12-08 10:00–11:00 PT (13:00–14:00 ET)
- Wed 2026-12-09 09:00–10:00 PT (12:00–13:00 ET)
- Wed 2026-12-09 10:00–11:00 PT (13:00–14:00 ET)

Sergio (cc'd) will join from our SE team to walk through performance/cost tradeoffs and answer technical questions. If you can confirm which time works and who from Acme will join, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda. I can also attach our security questionnaire in advance if Security wants to review.

Attach: discovery-agenda-Redwood-Acme.pdf (stub)

Quick TL;DR agenda: intros, current architecture & constraints, success metrics, data/security constraints, next steps.

Thanks,
Connor Obrien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
On a related note: HubSpot deal HS-3421 is the placeholder for this engagement.
From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@acmehealth.com>

Thanks Connor — this looks great. I looped in our engineering lead Rajiv and our procurement and security inboxes so they can weigh in. A couple notes:

- Our preference is to keep calls after 11:00 ET on workdays. Can we avoid anything earlier than that?
- Rajiv will want to join and cover data residency and integration questions.
- Security has asked for your questionnaire in advance so they can triage before the meeting.

If you can share an agenda + security questionnaire and send a couple confirmed time choices that meet the after-11:00 ET constraint, we'll confirm attendees.

Appreciate it —
Alice Morgan

Thanks — appreciate the options. A couple constraints on our side: we have a team standup until 12:30 ET on Wed, so can you push to 13:00 ET (your preferred slot) — that works for me. If 13:00 ET becomes difficult, Thu 11:30 ET (your backup) works too.

Also:
- Please include a short pre-call ask (1–2 bullets) so our SRE folks know whether to prepare logs/configs.
- Sergio — I'd like you to cover expected throughput/latency tradeoffs and cost assumptions.
- Security — we'll want to triage the attached questionnaire before the call; if you can flag high-priority items that'd be helpful.

If you confirm 13:00 ET Wed, I'll get our side added. Our team prefers a Slack channel for quick follow-ups — I'm rajiv_k on Slack if you'd like to add us.

Best,

Short pre-call asks (one-pagers are fine):
- Engineering: any integration docs or top-line architecture diagram you can share (high level only).
- SRE/Security: flag any compliance items or data residency rules that will affect hosting.

Who will bring the contract/PO timeline from procurement? Lauren (cc'd) will own follow-ups on our side and can coordinate contracting materials. Sergio will handle throughput/latency/cost discussion and will have a short slide deck ready.
